params.caption: 🎮 Palworld studio gives staff 5 days off for GTA 6 Pocketpair, the team behind Palworld, is giving its developers five days off to play GTA 6. The studio says "such a historic occasion deserves our full attention." It is not the first time: the CEO previously disappeared to play Slay the Spire 2. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 20:34 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @Palworld_EN · @RockstarGames 🙌 React if your boss should do this too · 💬 How many days off do you need? #Palworld #Pocketpair #GTA6 #GamingNews
